items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: He’s a happy guy. That’s his personality.

ctx.x: Well that’s what it’s all about. And I think you know one of the greatest players to me is Clark Terry. And it always comes out of him, out of his instrument, you understand what I’m saying? But he plays cute. He plays with a little lift and a little thing.
He’s a happy guy. That’s his personality. And most people do play their personalities you know. So if you happen to be funny, and there are a lot of musicians who are very funny,
they’re good joke tellers, and funny things happen to us too. I mean things that I don’t think happen to others.
